card.title: We Needed the Break
card.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

mechanism: A interprets a year apart as healthy growth and demonstrates the claimed benefit by accepting a new scheduling limit.
confusable: Unlike simply saying the rupture was good, the current response must treat its consequence as useful learning.
comparison: D89-a accepts Monday without turning delay into rejection; D89-b limits lunch numbers to avoid competitive family performance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
